name: Mayor Maple
bio: Hands out the jobs in Hard Hat Harbor's seaside town. Loves a good pothole fix.

portrait.subject: a cute cheerful town mayor woman with a yellow hard hat over red curls, a mayoral sash, a clipboard and a big friendly smile
portrait.background: sunny seaside toy town with construction trucks

request: Mayor Maple of Hard Hat Harbor! The town needs fixing, and I need friends! 🚧
hello: Wonderful! I've got a job board just for you.
Potholes on Main Street first. Always potholes first.
about: I'm Mayor Maple! Our little seaside town needs fixing, and you've got a toy box of trucks: dump truck, bulldozer, excavator, crane and more!
how: Pick a vehicle from the toy box and take jobs from the board: patch potholes, bulldoze rockslides, crane roofs, pour concrete and build a bridge.
tips: Read each job card. The right truck makes it easy!
Swing the wrecking ball gently at first.
chat: Farmer Gus found ANOTHER rock in his field.
The school roof is lovely now! Thanks to you!
The cannery's coming down soon. Bring the wrecking ball!
I wore my hard hat to dinner. Old habits.
nudge: The bridge needs its next span!
idle: {ago} without a job done! The potholes are back!
The trucks have been parked for {ago}. They're bored!
progress: You've finished {solved} jobs! The town looks wonderful!
update: Town news: Hard Hat Harbor updated to v{version}! 🚧
